name: portfolio-simulator-tests
description: Test harness for the Institutional Portfolio Simulator (tools/portfolio-simulator/index.html). The tool itself is a single static HTML file with no build step -- nothing here is shipped to users.

scripts.test:browser: npm run build:css && node tests/browser/desktop-diff.js && node tests/browser/mobile-audit.js && node tests/browser/heatmap-badge.js && node tests/browser/case-roundtrip.js && node tests/browser/pdf-export.js
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('playwright')}catch(e){console.log('note: playwright not installed -- npm test still works, npm run test:browser does not')}"

comments.devDependencies: These mirror what index.html loads from CDNs. Versions are pinned to the exact CDN versions so the browser suites test what users actually get -- if you change a CDN version in index.html, change it here too, or the suites stop being representative.
comments.xlsx: Pinned to match index.html. Both are due to move to a newer SheetJS release from cdn.sheetjs.com -- see tests/README.md.
comments.test:browser: Needs a Chromium build (npx playwright install chromium). Not run in CI: slow, and it needs a browser download.
